description:
Easy, reliable PDF creation from all applications.


- fixed bugs when viewing 1-page documents as thumbnails
- fixed bugs that sometimes caused unnecessary screen redrawing
- (Pro only) performance improvements in the Notes tab
- the application launched by the “View PDF” toolbar button can now be configured in the Settings dialog box
- PDF files that use the CalGray color space are now opened correctly
- fixed screen redraw bugs that sometimes happened when hand-panning a zoomed page display
